pull.title: jobs: add reusable saved search presets
pull.body:
## Summary
- add authenticated saved-search presets for public discovery filters
- persist optional query/category/min/max price with Flyway V21
- enforce max 20 presets per user, case-insensitive unique names and price/filter validation
- add create/list/update/delete API under `/saved-searches`
- let authenticated web users save currently applied filters and reopen them from `/saved-searches`
- mirror applied discovery filters into readable URL query parameters
- keep presets privacy-safe: no exact coordinates, private addresses or route geometry are stored
- document schema, API, privacy and validation behavior

## Validation
- Maven unit coverage for normalization, required criteria, duplicate names, price ranges, limits and updates
- existing API/runtime/Flyway smokes must remain green
- frontend lint/build and dependency audit must remain green

## Follow-up
Automatic notifications for new jobs matching a saved search are intentionally separated from this PR so job publication is not coupled to an unbounded synchronous user scan. The saved-search model is the stable input for an event/outbox-based alert pipeline in the next slice.
